summary: Independent initial canonical audit of all 175 Chinese units, 140 temporal or active-hint checks, and 52 people. It found ten bounded chronology groups: a succession point inflated to a reign interval, an open-ended Tongguang formula closed too early, and eight owner/context transfers from retrospective, posthumous, bibliographical, parental, or source-locator contexts. No unsupported replacement date is proposed; repairs must preserve the underlying undated facts and use reception or one-sided chronology where the Chinese warrants it.
